rows.evidence: R1 2nd @4.3: bumped at the start; near the 1400m raced in restricted room inside Incanto Star and, in the chain reaction when Winning Diamond shifted in (R Kingscote reprimanded), was checked when crowded by Excellent Boy (official; check seen on replay, lost ground along the rail); from 8th (official 8-8-7-2) angled off the rail in the straight and closed for 2nd, beaten 3/4 length (margin official) with the fastest last 400m in the race, 23.12 (official sectional); sent for sampling

R1 9th @3.6 favourite: from barrier 9 made use of to sit outside the leader (official 2-2-2-9); shifted in near the 1400m, starting the chain incident (R Kingscote reprimanded). Official: R Kingscote said it was disappointing in its failure to respond in the home straight; trainer D Eustace said it was disadvantaged by being made use of early from its wide barrier; vet inspection no significant findings; sent for sampling. Under pressure before the turn and faded (replay)

R1 10th @43: shifted in at the start and was bumped; raced keenly early and near the 1100m was steadied to avoid Can't Go Wong; continued to race keenly in the middle stages; vet inspection no significant findings (official). Replay only (not in stewards report): three-wide without cover from about the 1200m through the back straight and home turn (barrier 11, official 7-7-8-10)

R2 7th @7.3: shortly after the start shifted out and made contact with Iconical; near the 1000m checked to avoid Forza Leader, which shifted in when not clear (Z Purton careless riding, suspended) (official; loss of ground visible on replay, the shift itself obscured); official 4-4-7

R2 2nd @4.9: shortly after the start bumped by Loving Vibes; near the 900m, racing keenly, improved outside Rising Elite and shifted out making contact with Iconical (official; 900m contact hidden on replay); official 7-6-2, closed down the centre and beaten a short head (replay; margin official), last 400m 23.18 (official sectional); sent for sampling

R2 6th @29: shortly after the start steadied when crowded by Jolly Companion, which shifted in after being bumped (official; seen on replay); raced wide at the rear (replay) and was last at the 400m (official 12-12-6); ran on down the extreme outside with the fastest last 400m in the race, 23.00 (official sectional). Near the 100m shifted out, taking Lakeshore Hero wider (A Atzeni severely reprimanded) (official; seen on replay)

R2 8th @9.4: shifted in at the start and was bumped; near the 550m steadied when crowded between Iconical and Heroic Vanguard (official; not visible on replay); near the 300m unbalanced on contact with Jolly Companion, near the 150m contact again and shifted out when corrected; near the 100m hampered when taken wider by Majestic Delight (official; 300m-100m sequence seen on replay); official 11-10-8
R2 12th @92: raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event; near the 150m checked when crowded between Jolly Companion and Iconical (official; both seen on replay); official 5-7-12

R2 1st @3.2 favourite: Z Purton found guilty of careless riding near the 1000m (permitted mount to shift in when not clear of Autumn Vibes, which had to be checked); Purton suspended 23-27 Dec 2026 (2 racedays); result unchanged

R3 10th @8.9: official: L Ferraris said it travelled only fairly and he had to make use of it to hold its position; it experienced difficulty obtaining clear running over the concluding stages; in his opinion better suited ridden more conservatively early; vet inspection no significant findings. Held up behind runners on the rail in the straight (replay). The reviewer placed it near the rear on straight entry; official positions 6-6-5-7-10 were used instead

R3 6th @26: from 10th at the 400m (official 9-9-10-10-6) ran the fastest last 400m in the race, 22.99 (official sectional); close to the finish A Atzeni was obliged to stop riding and straighten it when it shifted in towards Best World (official; seen on replay)

R3 9th @12: from a wide barrier shifted across behind runners early; over the concluding stages raced in restricted room between Best World and Automated (which lay out) and could not be ridden out to the finish (official; seen on replay); official 11-11-9-5-9, beaten 3-1/4 lengths

R3 7th @7.6: over the concluding stages B Avdulla was obliged to stop riding and straighten it when racing tight outside Family Fortune (official; seen on replay); official 7-7-8-9-7, last 400m 23.35 (official sectional)

R3 1st @5.3 favourite: from barrier 9 crossed to lead on the rail (official 1-1-1-1-1); official race sectionals 13.86 / 23.39 / 24.21 / 24.27 / 23.67, i.e. a steadier middle before a 23.67 last 400m (pace note from sectionals only); kicked at the top of the straight and won by 1-3/4 lengths (replay; margin official); sent for sampling

R3 11th @8.6: M F Poon said he had to settle further back when caught wide early and was then satisfied with its finishing effort (official). Replay: three-wide without cover until about the 1300m, then restrained to the rear on the rail (official 8-12-12-12-11); last 400m 23.00 (official sectional, 2nd fastest in the race). Official vet: 'A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea. Before being allowed to race again, KING OF SELECTION will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.' Tracheal endoscopy finding, NOT bleeding from the nostrils; not a bleeder declaration

R4 3rd @9.2: shortly after the start crowded by Dragon Four Seas; near the 250m steadied when disappointed for clear running between Dragon Four Seas and Somelovefromabove (giving ground), switched outside Dragon Four Seas near the 200m; near the 150m lay out, taking Lightness Of Being out (M L Yeung warned) (official; seen clearly on head-on replay); official 6-5-3

R4 5th @10: H Bentley said the intention was a more forward position; caught wide early without the pace to go forward, he could not find cover and it raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event (official; seen on replay); near the 150m taken in slightly by Copartner Fleet (official, Vigor Happiness entry); official 7-8-5

R4 1st @15: dropped out and settled last early (official 12-11-1); circled wide from about the 600m around the home turn (replay; wide trip not in stewards report); near the 150m shifted in, taking World Hero in slightly (C Y Ho warned) (official); won by 3/4 length (official) with a 22.50 last 400m, the fastest of the meeting (official sectional). Race second section 22.71 (official) was quick and the first three at the first call finished 12th, 2nd and 8th; sent for sampling

R4 9th @3.2 favourite: jumped only fairly and settled back (official 11-12-9); near the 600m bumped the running rail (official; not confirmable on replay). D B McMonagle said the intention was a more forward position, he was satisfied with its finishing effort and in his opinion it would benefit from a step up in distance (official; rider opinion, untested). Vet inspection no significant findings; sent for sampling. Last 400m 22.95 (official sectional, 2nd fastest in the race)

R4 12th @13: E C W Wong said the intention was to lead; crossed to the front near the 900m (official 1-1-12); near the 150m shifted out under pressure and made contact with The Perfect Match; disappointing finishing effort, rider could offer no explanation; vet inspection no significant findings (official). Stopped quickly in the straight (replay); last 400m 24.98 (official sectional), after a quick 22.71 race second section
R4 11th @85: right hind plate refitted at the holding stables, examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race (official)

R5 2nd @3.8 favourite: bumped near the 250m (official; contact with Quick Contribution obscured on replay); ran on up the inner from 7th (official 7-7-2), beaten a short head, last 400m 22.80 (official sectional); sent for sampling

R5 3rd @7.9: shifted in at the start and was bumped; box seat (official 2-2-3); in the home straight hung out under pressure and proved difficult to ride out (official; seen on replay); approaching the finish shifted out, causing Tourbillon Golfer to be steadied (C Y Ho warned) (official)

R5 10th @9.5: shifted out on jumping and made contact with Beauty Thunder; A Atzeni said after settling back it had to make a wide run in the home straight; near the 100m steadied to avoid Cyclotron and unable to finish off thereafter (official). Replay only: three-wide without cover from about the 600m around the home turn (not stated by stewards, so no wide_no_cover flag); the 100m steadying was subtle on the side-on angle. Official 9-9-10
R5 8th @14: on jumping crowded between Noble Fans and Ruby Thrive, both of which shifted ground (official; badly squeezed on replay); handy (official 4-4-8)

R5 11th @25: after a short distance hampered when crowded between Cyclotron and Noble Fans; J Orman said the intention was midfield but it settled further back than intended; vet inspection no significant findings (official; crowding seen on replay); official 10-10-11

R5 7th @31: from the outside barrier shifted across behind runners early (official); last at the 400m (official 11-12-7) and ran the fastest last 400m in the race, 22.73 (official sectional), to finish 7th beaten 2-1/4 lengths

R5 12th @41: raced handy outside the leader (official 3-3-12) and weakened quickly on straight entry (replay). Official vet: 'Noted to have bled from both nostrils after the race. Before being allowed to race again, STARRY SHOW will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.' Listed under Bleeders in the stewards' summary

R6 8th @26: leaving the 200m checked when crowded between Enthralled (taken out by Exceed The Limit) and Vermilion Tempest (shifted in) (official; heavily checked on replay). Replay only: raced three-wide for part of the back straight with occasional cover. Official 6-7-8-8

R6 9th @5.1: shortly after the start bumped by Night Purosangue (official; seen on replay); passing the 200m lost its rightful running and had to be checked when Exceed The Limit shifted out (official; seen clearly on aerial and head-on replay); official 7-6-6-9. Official vet: 'A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea. Before being allowed to race again, ENTHRALLED will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.' Tracheal endoscopy finding, NOT bleeding from the nostrils; not a bleeder declaration

R6 3rd @9.9: jumped only fairly; near the 1600m shifted in and was bumped (official; contact with Sturdy Ruby obscured on replay); making the home turn steadied and switched inside Amazing Award to continue into clear running, then raced tight inside it for a short distance (official; seen on replay); from 11th at the 400m (official 9-10-11-3) closed along the rail, last 400m 23.32 (official sectional, 2nd fastest)

R6 5th @26: held up for clear running making the home turn; near the 100m switched outside Luck Is Back to continue into clear running and made contact with Uranus Star (official; 100m contact seen on replay). Replay only (not in stewards report): three-wide without cover from about the 1200m through the back straight (barrier 11, official 8-8-9-5)

R6 6th @2.7 favourite: Z Purton found guilty of careless riding passing the 200m (allowed mount to shift out when insufficiently clear of Enthralled, which lost its rightful running and had to be checked); Purton suspended 1 raceday, Wed 16 Dec 2026 at Happy Valley; result unchanged
R6 1st @8: A Badel reprimanded for shifting in leaving the 200m (contributing to Stormi being checked); result unchanged

R7 2nd @1.9 favourite: one-off third (official 3-3-2); leaving the 150m inconvenienced when taken wider by Hero Mastermind, then slight contact; the protest was overruled as the Stewards could not be comfortably satisfied that it would otherwise have finished ahead (official; seen on replay); beaten a head (official); sent for sampling

R7 2nd @1.9 favourite: protest lodged by E C W Wong (rider of WINNING MACHINE) against HERO MASTERMIND alleging interference inside the final 150m; Stewards overruled it (could not be comfortably satisfied WINNING MACHINE would otherwise have finished ahead); result unchanged, beaten a head
R7 1st @26: shifted out under pressure leaving 150m, inconveniencing Winning Machine; protest by E C W Wong overruled by the Stewards, result unchanged
R7 6th @12: jumped only fairly (official); from 11th at the 400m (official 11-11-6) ran the fastest last 400m in the race, 22.94 (official sectional)

R7 4th @24: shortly after the start made contact with Flying Ting Lok, both shifting ground; near the 600m lay in, crowding Call Me Success; in the home straight lay in under pressure and near the 200m was reluctant to shift to the outside of Incredible Moment (official; one-paced on replay); official 4-4-4
R7 5th @7.1: S Osborne became ill in the parade ring and was stood down by the Club CMO; H Bentley substituted

R7 12th @18: raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event (official; seen on replay); L Ferraris said it travelled only fairly and, concerned something was amiss in the home straight, he eased it down; vet inspection no significant findings (official). Official 5-6-12, beaten 9-3/4 lengths

R7 9th @14: shortly after the start made contact with Charming Babe, both shifting ground (official; seen on replay); official 7-7-9. Official vet: 'A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea. Before being allowed to race again, FLYING TING LOK will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.' Tracheal endoscopy finding, NOT bleeding from the nostrils; not a bleeder declaration

R7 11th @73: jumped only fairly, then hampered by Without Rhyme, which shifted out (official; seen on replay); official 9-8-11. Official vet: 'Noted to have bled from both nostrils after the race. Before being allowed to race again, ORIGIN OF FORM will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.' Listed under Bleeders in the stewards' summary

R8 withdrawn 24.11.26 by order of the Stewards on veterinary advice (irregular heart rhythm), replaced by standby Precision Time; before racing again must perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination
R8 3rd @60: Standby Declared Starter, promoted to replace SUNDAY'S SERENADE (withdrawn 24.11.26 on vet advice); entered for Sha Tin 29 Nov per HKJC entries list

R8 4th @2.6 favourite: official: sent for sampling, no other comment. On the rail (official 5-5-5-4); replay only (not in stewards report): in the straight had to angle off the rail around the weakening Flying Wrote; the reviewer judged it minor, effect unverified. Last 400m 22.98 (official sectional, equal fastest in the race)

R8 6th @18: shifted out at the start and made contact with Happy Boss; from a wide barrier shifted across behind runners early (official; seen on replay); last to the 800m (official 12-12-8-6), last 400m 22.98 (official sectional, equal fastest in the race)

R8 9th @10: shortly after the start shifted out and made contact with Pass Line; C Y Ho said it was disadvantaged by a wide run on the home turn and finished only fairly; vet inspection no significant findings (official; four-to-five wide on the turn on replay); official 9-9-6-9

R8 7th @5.8: jumped awkwardly (official; seen on replay); C L Chau said in his opinion it may have been disadvantaged racing towards the inside but finished one-paced; vet inspection no significant findings (official). Clear run up the inside rail in the straight without quickening (replay). Official 8-7-9-7

R9 2nd @2.4 favourite: raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event (official; three-wide from about the 1000m on replay); beaten a short head (official) with a 22.84 last 400m (official sectional) despite the wide trip; sent for sampling

R9 6th @30: S Osborne indisposed, A Atzeni substituted (official). Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with California Blitz; held up for clear running between the 300m and 200m (official; seen on replay); last at the 400m (official 12-12-6), fastest last 400m in the race, 22.72 (official sectional)

R9 4th @12: near the 1000m eased when momentarily crowded by Quantum Cloud (official; steadying seen on replay); from 8th (official 8-7-4) finished strongly down the outside (replay), last 400m 22.84 (official sectional)

R9 8th @47: shifted out at the start and made contact with Ace Champion; approaching the 300m disappointed for clear running outside Quantum Cloud, which shifted out, and switched to the inside to continue into clear running (official; seen on replay); official 9-8-8

R9 7th @4: bumped on jumping (official; Brave Star shifted out into it on replay); C Y Ho could offer no explanation for its disappointing performance; trainer P C Ng said in his opinion it may not have been suited by carrying 134 lbs (official). Official 10-10-7. Official vet: 'A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have blood in the mouth.' No clearance requirement is stated in the report
R9 7th @4: official vet found blood in the mouth after the race; no clearance requirement stated in the report (Steward Bot: non-material)

R9 10th @23: led one-off; E C W Wong told Stewards instructions were to lead if possible without making too much use of it because LIGHTNESS OF MUSIC has previously been declared a bleeder and was stepping up from 1000m to 1200m; Stewards found the tactics reasonable. Weakened in the straight (replay). No new vet finding reported

R9 11th @16: approaching the 1000m improved inside Flashing Fighter and was steadied when momentarily crowded; passing the 350m shifted out to improve and made contact with Flashing Fighter (official; seen on replay); official 6-5-11. Official vet: 'A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm. Before being allowed to race again, QUANTUM CLOUD will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.'
R9 6th @30: S Osborne indisposed, A Atzeni substituted (official)
